dev.effects: Applies local D1 migrations and starts the loopback Vite development server; writes local retained state.

build.effects: Builds local Worker and client artifacts; does not deploy.

verify.effects: Runs typecheck, build and existing contract/foundation/platform checks; uncovered requirements may remain.

setup.effects: Validates setup inputs, provisions Cloudflare D1/R2/Queue, writes local deployment config/cache, applies remote D1 migrations and uploads configured secrets.

deploy.effects: Runs setup including remote migrations, builds the Worker/client, deploys dist/server/wrangler.json, then requests health and checks database/files reachability.

backup.effects: Creates a server-side owner export and downloads an archive to a new mode-0600 local file; requires SLATE_APP_URL and current owner SLATE_SESSION_COOKIE. Replace ARCHIVE.zip with destination path.

restore.effects: Uploads an archive and restores into an empty deployment as its authenticated setup owner; writes remote data and files. Requires SLATE_APP_URL and SLATE_SESSION_COOKIE. Replace ARCHIVE.zip with source path; independent restore acceptance is pending.

dev-local-ai.effects: Starts loopback Slate development and a private-token local Codex evidence bridge using existing codex login; applies local migrations and retains local state. Optional SLATE_AI_MODEL defaults to gpt-6-astra. Inference sends authorized evidence to Codex; no hosted provider acceptance. Stops owned children on exit.

source-check.effects: Reads tracked source and retained comparison material; rejects source or migration drift; no deployment.

integration-sync.effects: Rewrites derived management resource recipe and provenance from actual source; review diff, stage and relock.

artifact.effects: Requires clean committed source and a matching native build receipt; writes local delivery-artifact bundle with exact Worker modules, client assets and SQL. No deployment or admission.

deployment-check.effects: Validates local deployment input names and syntax only. Missing configuration fails; never authenticates, provisions or claims provider readiness.
